title: The Swapping Mechanism for Interacting Diffusions: Framework, Comparison with Switching, and an Exactly Solvable Example
summary: We develop a rigorous framework for the swapping mechanism for two interacting jump-diffusion processes: each particle evolves independently but their positions are exchanged at random times, providing a continuous-time description of the replica-exchange Monte Carlo. Under mild hypotheses we establish strong existence, pathwise uniqueness, and a forward Kolmogorov equation for the transition density.
